quote.text: Facts do not cease to exist because they are ignored.
quote.author: Aldous Huxley, Proper Studies, 1927

stories.kicker: The Atelier · Tool Chests & Roller Cabinets
stories.headline: Harbor Freight’s $899 cabinet matches Snap-on’s $7,355 box on slides and casters
stories.dek: Gerstner still hand-fits hardwood drawers in Dayton and asks $5,395 for seven of them, rated 90 lb each — less than the cheap steel box carries.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Real Rate
stories.headline: St Louis Fed’s Musalem asks for several more rate rises by spring
stories.dek: He wants the inflation-adjusted policy rate “solidly” between 2 and 2.5 per cent by spring 2027; the ten-year bond market already pays 2.89.

stories.headline: Indonesia built 28,662 Kopdes Merah Putih shops in 2026 and opened 10,070
stories.dek: The Rp 240 trillion that paid for them was lent not to a cooperative but to PT Agrinas Pangan Nusantara, a renamed state engineering consultancy, at 6 per cent over 72 months.

stories.headline: Ukraine fells a Kerch Bridge arch; Russia suspends all traffic to Crimea
stories.dek: Zelenskyy called it the seventh phase of an operation running for weeks, a night after Russia’s defence ministry claimed a war-record 1,336 drones shot down.

stories.headline: Singapore’s October exports rose 79.8 per cent; shipments to America more than tripled
stories.dek: Enterprise Singapore published the figures on 17 November, a day after its own deadline; pharmaceuticals alone added S$2.3 billion, up 253.1 per cent.

stories.headline: Kress delivers Nvidia’s record $115.8 billion quarter and guides margins lower
stories.dek: Colette Kress, interim chief executive since 11 November, reported data-centre revenue of $107.6 billion, up 110 per cent, then guided fourth-quarter gross margin to 71 or 72 per cent from 74.8.

stories.headline: Google and Samsung open pre-orders for display-free camera glasses at US$395
stories.dek: They reach shops on 10 December in the United States and South Korea only; Samsung rates the 41-gram frames at nine hours, and nobody outside the company has measured them.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Zenith And J.N. Shapiro
stories.headline: Zenith prices a Shapiro-engraved Calibre 135 at 68,900 francs, in 25 pieces
stories.dek: Joshua Shapiro cut the movement bridges as well as the silver dial, a first for the series — and the reason it costs 10,000 francs more than the platinum edition before it.

stories.headline: Raye leads the 2027 Grammy nominations with eleven; Beyoncé reaches one hundred
stories.dek: The Recording Academy published the field on 16 November: Rosalía has nine, and seven of the eight Album of the Year nominees are women.

stories.headline: World Health Organization counts 240 million adolescents with no active day
stories.dek: Not one, in the week before they were asked. Fiona Bull’s team pooled 389 surveys and 3.2 million 11- to 17-year-olds across 140 countries, and found no global change since 2010.

stories.headline: The Morris Museum keeps 750 machines that play music without a recording
stories.dek: Antoine Favre-Salomon of Geneva replaced tuned bells with a steel comb in 1796; the societies that collect what followed are down to about 1,400 members each.

stories.headline: Sports Medicine review finds cold water reliably eases soreness and little else
stories.dek: Liang and colleagues, publishing on 23 October, rated 12 of the 14 reviews they gathered as critically low in confidence.

stories.headline: Singapore’s National Gallery ends its Pop after Pop discount on 30 November
stories.dek: Maria Taniguchi’s show at the Singapore Art Museum closes on 22 November, and tickets for Tokyo’s January sumo tournament go on sale at 10am on 5 December.
